label: Placebo
rationale: The study is explicitly described as comparing RE104 to an active-placebo, and it is randomized and double-blind. Even though the arm list only shows two RE104 dose arms, the summary states an active-placebo comparator is part of the study design, so this counts as a placebo-controlled study and the affected comparator part should be reviewed.
reviewReason: The arm groups shown do not include the active-placebo arm, creating a conflict between the summary/design language and the listed arms.
title: RE104 Safety and Efficacy Study in Adjustment Disorder in Cancer and Other Medical Illnesses

rule.label: No placebo
